headline: Good News, Elon: JPMorgan's New Tesla Analyst Just Ditched Years Of Bearish Calls And Flipped Bullish
summary: JPMorgan's new analyst triples Tesla's price target to $475, abandoning a years-long bearish call to focus on Elon Musk's 'physical AI' and robotics edge.

headline: Monroe Capital Becomes Latest Private Credit Manager To Restrict Withdrawals
summary: Monroe Capital joins other private credit fund managers in capping its redemptions at 5%, as investors sought to redeem approximately 10%.
